note: Chain payload with the per-step-invariant tensors hoisted into static/. Load static/*.pt once and merge them into every step's dict before replaying the chain. Ships the first 8 consecutive steps; the chained gate compares the final state after replaying them in order. The conv-state pool is stored as the touched rows only (in_conv_states__rows.pt, selected by cache_indices); rebuild a pool of the recorded full shape and scatter the rows into it if your kernel wants the pool.
